research.notes: OFCY is a City of Oakland program, not a separate legal entity, so no EIN, CA entity number or UEI and no separate legal name. The City's own OFCY page lists a different address (1 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza) than the OFCY site (150 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza, Suite 4216); the OFCY contact page address is used.

profile.address: 150 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza, Suite 4216, Oakland, CA 94612
profile.summary: The Oakland Fund for Children and Youth (OFCY) is a grantmaking program of the City of Oakland's Human Services Department. It provides funding to community-based organizations and agencies that offer enrichment and support services to Oakland children and youth from birth to 21 years of age.
